name: Overhead triceps stretch
summary: One arm overhead, elbow bent so the hand drops behind the neck; the other hand draws the elbow across.
setup: Face the phone. Reach the working arm up, bend the elbow so the hand drops behind the head, and use the other hand on the elbow to draw it gently toward the midline. Hold.
brief: Reach the working arm up, bend the elbow so the hand drops behind the head, and use the other hand on the elbow to draw it gently toward the midline.
why: Facing the phone the working upper arm is held near vertical, so the timer runs only while the elbow is up.
progression: Lean gently to the opposite side.

faults.label: Head pushed forward
faults.tip: Letting the head drift forward turns a triceps stretch into neck strain.

faults.label: Leaning away
faults.tip: A side lean fakes the stretch; keep the trunk upright.

faults.label: Shoulder hiking
faults.tip: Let the shoulder drop while the elbow points up.

faults.label: Arching the ribs
faults.tip: When the shoulder runs out of range the ribs flare. Stop before that.

points.t: Elbow up and drawn toward the midline.
